svg.aria-label: Clickable prototype of the Girl Effect iPhone app, stepping through featured actions, prioritizing, search, map, profile and goal screens

g.text: Actions in a category, sized by value. Tap one to rate it.
Tap, hold and drag an action to rank it from high to low.
Search for an action within a category.
See activities nearby and how many girls take part.
Track points earned per action and girl coins spent.
Compare earned, spent and pending points with a goal.
Tap the screen or a step to explore
